title: NEW Quick Pro UR:ONE vs Tarmac SL8 (Wind Tunnel Tested) — HALF the Price, SAME Performance?

takeaways.text: The UR:ONE is Quick Pro's flagship and most expensive frame, an ultralight all-rounder rather than a pure race aero bike.
Claimed weights for a painted size medium: frame 685 g with metal hardware and uncut fork 340 g; the raw wind-tunnel frame weighed 609 g before paint.
Of four shape candidates the brand chose the lighter, stiffer MX7 over a slightly more aero option; Silverstone testing with a full yaw sweep showed differences under about 0.7 W between candidates.

disclosure: Pedaler attended Quick Pro's launch and relays the brand's engineering briefing; figures are manufacturer claims.
summary: A summary of Quick Pro's launch briefing for the UR:ONE ultralight all-round race frame, including claimed weights and wind-tunnel testing.
